corrections.title: Add non-provisional Traya S/62 and Darth Vader A/61 5v5 Geonosians counters
corrections.rationale: Issue #169 records the owner's explicit approval of GAC-GEO5-1 Option A: add two non-provisional scored counters against the exact existing 5v5 Geonosians defence, appended after the existing JAWAS, VEERS and BOSSK rows. TRAYA already exists as a global counter definition and is reused unchanged; VADER is a new attacker Counter_ID for original Darth Vader, distinct from LORD_VADER and DARTH_VADER_DUALS_END, requiring only DARTH_VADER without prescribing an exact attacking five.

evidence.supports: Owner approval of GAC-GEO5-1 Option A as explicitly decided in the 7 November 2026 ChatGPT conversation and documented in the issue body as provenance: TRAYA S/62 and VADER A/61, both undersize 0 and non-provisional, against the exact 5v5 Geonosians defence; exact notes text; tiers and default banner scores are owner-approved planning judgments, not measured banner averages or current-season win rates.

provenance.conditions: 5v5: Geonosians defence. TRAYA: Traya-led Sith (Traya and Nihilus required, Sion optional support). VADER: original Darth Vader with Merciless Massacre; adequate opening speed and gear are important; full attacking five is not prescribed. Omicron, datacron, relic and mod conditions not recorded.
provenance.confidence: Medium for the planning values: the owner has firsthand historical experience of both counters succeeding in 5v5 and explicitly approved the tiers and default banner scores; no statistical win rate or measured banner average is claimed.
provenance.limitations: Historical success only; current-season repeatability unverified. Current exact-lineup win rates, datacron independence, exact relic/mod thresholds and averaged banners were not established. Banner scores are approved planning estimates, not measured averages.

affectedReferences.effect: AMEND exact approved row: existing JAWAS B/60, VEERS B/61 and BOSSK B/61 rows and their order are preserved; TRAYA S/62 then VADER A/61 are appended, both undersize 0 and non-provisional.
ADD exact approved row: new attacker Counter_ID for original Darth Vader.

runtimeImpact.5v5: Geonosians gains two scored, non-provisional counters appended in authored order: TRAYA S/62 and VADER A/61, both undersize 0; existing JAWAS B/60, VEERS B/61 and BOSSK B/61 counters and their order are unchanged.
runtimeImpact.3v3: none - checked: 3v3 Geonosian and Traya-related rows untouched.
runtimeImpact.counters: VADER counter definition added (Darth Vader, required DARTH_VADER, no recommended members, no strategicReserve flag); TRAYA definition unchanged.
runtimeImpact.roundAvailability: Counter identity is unchanged for existing options; the new options expose the existing required-character availability behaviour: using DARTH_VADER, DARTH_TRAYA or DARTH_NIHILUS anywhere makes dependent counters unavailable, and counters sharing a required character still cannot both be spent.
runtimeImpact.scoring: none - checked: existing tier and bannerScore taxonomy (S and A, 62 and 61) with undersize 0; no constants, score meanings or calculations changed.
runtimeImpact.strategicReserve: none - checked: no definition gains a strategicReserve flag.

counters.notes: Traya-led Sith; use Traya and Nihilus, with Sion as an optional support. Owner confirms historical 5v5 success. 62 is an approved planning estimate, not a measured banner average. Confirm gear, abilities and datacrons; current-season repeatability unverified.
